<!-- en -->
v0.2.10 improves collection reliability when client databases are briefly locked and fixes stale router collection errors after recovery.

- **External SQLite reads.** Read-only connections to external SQLite databases, including the CC Switch router database, now wait up to 2 seconds for each lock conflict that SQLite can wait on. Multiple waits can add up during a collection run.
- **Router collection recovery.** When the daemon successfully completes incremental router collection for a client, it automatically resolves outstanding errors previously recorded by that path for the same client, including errors from earlier dates. The `token-usage collect router` command is for manual attribution backfills.

If you installed from an official release, upgrade with `token-usage update`. The updater automatically restarts a running daemon. If the daemon was stopped, you can run `token-usage daemon start` after the update completes to resume background collection.

<!-- zh -->
v0.2.10 减少外部数据库短时锁定导致的采集失败，并修复路由采集恢复后历史错误仍显示为未解决的问题。

- **读取外部 SQLite 数据库。** 只读访问外部 SQLite 数据库（包括 CC Switch 的路由库）时，每次遇到 SQLite 可以等待的锁竞争，最多等待 2 秒。同一轮采集中的多次等待可以累加。
- **路由采集恢复。** 守护进程为某个客户端执行的路由增量采集整轮成功后，会自动结案这条路径此前为该客户端登记的未解决错误，包括更早日期的记录。`token-usage collect router` 用于手动回填路由归因。

通过官方发行版安装的用户可使用 `token-usage update` 升级。升级会自动重启原本在运行的守护进程。如果守护进程之前已停止，可在更新完成后运行 `token-usage daemon start` 恢复后台采集。
